prompts.zombie_riders: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied zombie animation sheet. Create a production game sprite sheet, transparent background, same cute horror cartoon green zombie with purple swept hair, red-orange eyes, ragged purple shirt and brown shorts, same illustrated outlines and palette. Fix anatomy and driving poses for our side-scrolling jet ski game. EXACT regular grid: 4 columns, 3 rows, 12 equal square cells, generous transparent padding on all four sides of EVERY cell, no cell touches. All characters face RIGHT, perfectly profile, fixed camera and consistent body size. Row 1 FOUR consecutive pilot animation frames: truly SITTING astride a jet ski with hip on a seat, knees bent at right angles, one near lower leg downward on a footrest, far leg hidden behind the vehicle. EXACTLY TWO anatomically connected arms, both extended forward and slightly down, hands at the handlebar position, small elbow and shoulder changes absorbing bumps. NO third arm, NO disconnected green shapes or ghost body. Row 2 FOUR seated REAR PASSENGER frames: same seat/hip baseline, gripping a strap in front of the lap with TWO arms, slight recoil, knees bent, only near leg visible. Row 3 FOUR DUCKING DRIVER frames forming a seamless loop: same planted hip, torso leaning forward with chest LOW over the knees, head tucked down but recognizable, two hands always on handlebar, neck and shoulders naturally connected, knees and foot stay in seated pose. Full intact faces in every frame, opaque skin, no translucent flesh or holes. Preserve this exact character identity and the art style of input. Body silhouette must read as seated and controlling a vehicle, never running or floating. NO vehicle, NO background, NO text, NO grids or labels, NO shadow outside character. Each frame self-contained, entire head/hair/foot visible with at least 12% empty margin. Keep clothing/cape behind the two correct arms. The four frames per row should be consecutive coherent motion, not unrelated poses.

Top LEFT: a beautifully built long LOW SIDE-VIEW exit ramp pointing RIGHT, a continuous upward sloping dark worn timber deck from low left to raised right, supported by gothic dark teal masonry pier and iron rivets, gold bronze trim, wet moss. Pure horizontal side view, ramp surface slope about 22 degrees, broad curved takeoff lip, no diagonal perspective. Top RIGHT: a SINGLE slim vertical jagged iron-and-bone SPIKE pointed UP, on a heavy dark teal mossy stone foundation with bronze bolts, game obstacle planted into canal floor, clear sharp silhouette, not a pile of random blocks. Bottom LEFT: a heavy dark teal gothic masonry PLINTH / pedestal for a water pump: stone base and two low side buttresses, empty top socket for a round pump, wet moss, subtle skull carving and rusty bronze bolts, opaque dark stone, no white background or cut-out squares. Bottom RIGHT: a low suspended gothic iron portcullis horizontal bar with sharp downward spikes, two upright mounting brackets and long chains reaching UP within the cell, gold bronze rivets and dark teal iron, physically coherent outline. Same saturated hand-painted outlined cartoon game art as reference, dark purple/teal/bronze, crisp closed black contour, modest dimensional shading, no photorealism or pixel art. All four objects viewed exactly from the side. NO background, NO text, NO labels, NO grid lines, NO characters or vehicles, NO surrounding scene or ground/water planes. Genuine transparency around each isolated complete object. Do not include a white rectangle or a fake checkerboard.
